title: 第17章 相似的场景第18章 内门好处
slug: 从一证永证开始成神第432章
content_zh:
;;
哑巷的夜风又潮又冷，钻进衣领，冷得人骨头发紧。
叶霄从武馆出来时，天已经黑透。
今日桩功与拳法练到极狠，腿脚发酸，虎口裂了又合。表面看不出伤，骨缝里却一阵阵发空，寒意直往里钻。
还能撑。
但再这么撑下去，迟早会断。
弄药的心越发强烈。
离馆前，他向何临打听过下城几家药铺的路数。
他没直接回哑巷，而是顺着街道绕了过去。
第一家灯笼亮得刺眼，掌柜连眼皮都懒得抬：“没条子，不卖。”
第二家门匾斑驳，掌柜把他从头扫到脚，嗤了一声：“外门学员？想买入流药？有条子再来吧。”
叶霄把价抬到一倍。
对方只回三个字：“不合规。”
他再绕了两条巷子，找了三家药铺都是相似的回复。正当他准备作罢时，在偏僻巷角看见一盏半死不活的油灯。
灯下是一家不起眼的药铺，门半掩着，里面潮气很重。
柜台后坐着个老者，眼皮松垂，打量他的目光却不算迟钝。
叶霄直说来意。
老者抬了抬眼：“想买入流药？而且没条子？”
叶霄点头。
老者笑了一声，笑意却有些冷：“那就走偏门，三流有，甚至二流药也不是没有……”

“多少钱？”叶霄问。
老者伸出五根手指，不紧不慢：“市价五倍，钱到手，药给你。但记住了，你走出这门后，这买卖我不认。”
叶霄沉默。
他身上的钱，加一倍勉强还行，两倍都不一定够。
五倍……连想都不用想。
“买不起就别问。”老者嗤笑：“这地方，命不值钱，药值。”
油灯在柜台上晃了晃，叶霄转身离开。
身后那扇门合上时发出一声干脆的“吱呀”，把这条路也合死了。
……
回巷的路上，叶霄把账一条条压在心里。
三流药买不起。
不入流的汤药他试过，顶多让人不至于立刻垮……离当燃料用，还差得很远。
哑巷的潮和炉灰压着人鼻子，眼前也蒙着一层灰。
远处北炉的方向还有火光在跳，那是这条巷的夜里最扎眼的亮。
叶霄沿着破墙往里走，脚步压在潮湿的地面上，几乎没声。
就在这时……
前方忽然传来一道骨断的脆响，紧接着是短促而刺耳的惨叫。
叶霄脚步顿住。
疲惫被那声响硬生生撕开，整个人反倒静了下来。
content_en:
;;
The night wind in the dumb alley was damp and cold, getting into my collar and making my bones tense with coldness.
When Ye Xiao came out of the martial arts hall, it was already dark.
Today I practiced the Zhuang Kung Fu and boxing skills to the extreme. My legs and feet are sore, and the tiger's mouth is cracking and closing. There were no injuries visible on the surface, but the bones felt hollow and chilly.
It can still hold up.
But if it continues like this, it will break sooner or later.
The desire to get medicine became stronger and stronger.
Before leaving the hotel, he asked He Lin for directions to several drug stores in the lower city.
He did not go back directly to Mute Alley, but went around along the street.
The first store's lanterns were so bright that the shopkeeper didn't even bother to raise his eyelids: "No money, no money."
The plaque on the door of the second house was mottled, and the shopkeeper swept him from head to toe and sneered: "Outer sect student? Want to buy popular medicine? Come back when you have a note."
Ye Xiao doubled the price.
The other party only replied with three words: "Illegal."
He detoured two more alleys and found three pharmacies, all of which gave similar responses. Just when he was about to give up, he saw a half-dead oil lamp in a remote corner.
Under the lamp is an inconspicuous drug store, the door is ajar, and there is a lot of moisture inside.
There was an old man sitting behind the counter, his eyelids were droopy, but his eyes looking at him were not dull.
Ye Xiao bluntly stated his intention.
The old man raised his eyes: "Want to buy illegal drugs? And you don't have a note?"
Ye Xiao nodded.
The old man laughed, but his smile was a little cold: "Then take a sideways approach. There are third-rate medicines, and even second-rate medicines are not without..."
"How much?" Ye Xiao asked.
The old man held out five fingers and said unhurriedly: "Five times the market price, I'll give you the medicine when you get the money. But remember, after you walk out of this door, I don't recognize this transaction."
Ye Xiao was silent.
Doubling the amount of money he has is barely enough, but doubling it may not be enough.
Five times...without even thinking about it.
"If you can't afford it, don't ask." The old man sneered: "Life is worthless in this place, but medicine is."
The oil lamp swayed on the counter, and Ye Xiao turned around and left.
The door behind him closed with a crisp "squeak", closing the road.
…
On the way back to the alley, Ye Xiao kept the accounts in his mind one by one.
I can’t afford third-rate medicine.
He had tried some unfashionable decoctions, but at most they would not cause immediate collapse... but they were still far from being used as fuel.
The tide and ashes in the dumb alley pressed against people's noses, and their eyes were covered with a layer of ashes.
There was fire dancing in the distance in the direction of Beilu, which was the most dazzling light in this alley at night.
Ye Xiao walked along the broken wall, her footsteps pressed against the wet ground, making almost no sound.
Just then...
Suddenly there was a crisp sound of bones breaking from the front, followed by a short and piercing scream.
Ye Xiao paused.
The fatigue was torn away by the sound, and the whole person became silent.
